title: Safeguard Manifest
description: Declares a host safeguard (idempotent machine-state modification) managed by the Vrooli runtime

name.description: Unique safeguard identifier matching the handler registry name

handler.description: Name of the Go handler that implements Inspect and Apply for this safeguard

platforms.description: Platforms this safeguard applies to. Omit for all platforms.

risk.description: Operator-facing risk indicator. 'low' = no system state changes outside Vrooli's tree (probes, reads); 'medium' = writes config files outside Vrooli's tree or modifies networking rules; 'high' = modifies kernel parameters or requires root in ways that broadly affect host behavior. Used by onboarding to surface risk before opt-in.

verificationCheck.description: Optional verification that the safeguard's apply step took effect.

notes.description: Freeform annotation for maintainers (not shown to users during install)
